Bessarabian Village Birth Records, 1881-85 (R. Drefs)

        Published by the Odessa Digital Library - 17 May 1998
             http://www.odessa3.org

        This file contains birth records from the Bessarabian villages
        of South Russia for the years 1881 through 1885.  No records are 
        available for 1880.  This information was compiled by R. Reuben
        Drefs, coordinator and volunteer Rosemarie Riemer from the St.
        Petersburg Lutheran Evangelical archives published by the LDS.
        Edited by Marty McMahon, updated 5-17-98 and 11-23-98.
